provenance: Independent Canvas reconstruction of the complete nine-genre recursive call and return narrative. No source frames or video are loaded by the composition.
limitations: 保留完整九种风格与递归调用/返回叙事，但卡通人物、像素关卡、蕨叶和电影质感均为独立几何绘制，与原插画和材质存在明显差异。
字幕取自已观察画面，不是逐字完整音频转写；个别字幕与音频微小时序仍需进一步校准。
字体、景深、光晕、表情、子窗口镜头以及快切时间仍近似，未逐像素一致。

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
